newsitem.title: UK: UKAV says will abstain at Greycoat EGM.
newsitem.headline: UKAV says will abstain at Greycoat EGM.

text.p: UK Active Value Fund (UKAV) said on Wednesday it will abstain at Thursday's extraordinary meeting (EGM) of property company Greycoat Plc, called to consider a proposal to merge with Moorfield Estates and sell-off some Greycoat assets.

UKAV said in a statement that following talks with Greycoat and the company's acceptance of a return of 100 million stg of equity to shareholders via the realisation of its Embankment Place office investment, UKAV said it will not now vote in favour of liquidating Greycoat's portfolio at the EGM.
UKAV said it anticipates further progress towards unlocking shareholder value at Greycoat.
Moorfield has put forward detailed proposals to Greycoat shareholders for the demerger of Greycoat's principal properties and the merger of the remainder with Moorfield.
UKAV said it has realised its immediate goals and will therefore abstain in Thursday's vote.

"UKAV will continue to monitor...the progress of the Moorfield proposals and Greycoat's realisation of its principal properties. It reserves the right to requisition an EGM in due course if further attempts to unlock value for shareholders are frustrated," UKAV said.
